description: This file contains the class ElasticSearchHooks, which handles logic hooks for synchronizing the Elasticsearch index with SugarCRM/SuiteCRM beans upon save or delete events. It includes methods for processing save and delete callbacks, reindexing beans, handling errors, and controlling indexing actions based on configuration and module blacklists.

classes.name: ElasticSearchHooks
classes.description: Handles logic hooks to keep the Elasticsearch index synchronized with SugarCRM/SuiteCRM beans, responding to save and delete events and performing re-indexing actions accordingly.

methods.name: beanSaved
methods.description: Callback invoked after a SugarBean is saved; triggers re-indexing if Elasticsearch indexing is enabled.

methods.name: beanDeleted
methods.description: Callback invoked after a SugarBean is deleted; triggers removal from index if Elasticsearch indexing is enabled.

methods.name: reIndexSafe
methods.description: Safely attempts to re-index a bean, catching and handling any exceptions thrown during the process.

methods.name: reIndex
methods.description: Performs the re-indexing or removal of a bean, checking if the indexer is enabled and the module is not blacklisted.

methods.name: getIndexer
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the indexer instance used for indexing operations.

methods.name: isBlacklisted
methods.description: Checks if the current bean's module is blacklisted from indexing.

methods.name: correctAction
methods.description: Adjusts the action to 'remove' if the bean is marked as deleted.

methods.name: performAction
methods.description: Executes the indexing or removal of the bean based on the specified action.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Logs errors encountered during re-indexing operations.
